## Home: Apple TV-style carousel

- **Continue Playing** becomes a carousel with your **last 5 games**, in the style of the Apple TV app:
  - The game's background art fills the top of the screen, fading gently into the rows below.
  - The game's logo in the centre, then when you last played and your hours (white), and your Steam achievements (grey).
  - A white **Play** button (Resume when the game is running) and a round **•••** button with the game options. Tapping anywhere else opens the game page.
  - After 5 seconds the game's **Steam trailer** plays over the art, muted. A mute button appears next to the PC button. When the trailer ends the carousel moves on to the next game; games without a trailer move on after 8 seconds.
  - Dots at the bottom: the current one fills as the game's turn goes by. Swipe, tap a dot, or use ← / → on the controller to change game; ✕ plays.
  - On iPhone in landscape the carousel fills the screen; on iPad it takes the top of the screen, like the Apple TV app.
- New **Settings › Home › Autoplay Trailers**: Always, Wi-Fi Only (default) or Off.
- The "Play Now" title still fades into the glass bar as you scroll.

## Cards

- **Ready to Play**: Apple TV-style landscape cards with the game's art and logo, and a status line at the bottom: achievements progress bar, hours played and a ••• menu.
- **Library and Search**: portrait covers (Steam or SteamGridDB) like the Apple TV app's posters, with your hours played at the bottom (nothing when you haven't played). Bigger on iPad, at the Apple TV app's size. A green dot marks games ready to play.
